_meta.source: Goliath-Research Astra AstraConfig (SQL Server 2016 backup 2017-07-05), migrated to PostgreSQL schema `config`; extracted from db-migration/postgres/02_data.sql
_meta.note: Credential-free extract of the Access-era pinout tables and the configurator hardware tree. No Servers rows, passwords or connection strings. Column names are the PostgreSQL (lower-cased) names; see README.md in this directory for joins.
